prepare-fractions.title: Prepare the fractions
prepare-fractions.explanation: A mixed number contains a whole number and a fraction. An improper fraction writes the whole amount as one fraction.
prepare-fractions.guidance: Before combining mixed numbers, multiply the whole number by the denominator and add the numerator.

common-denominator.title: common denominator
common-denominator.explanation: The denominator tells you the size of the equal parts. Fractions need the same-sized parts before you add or subtract them.
common-denominator.guidance: Multiply the top and bottom of a fraction by the same number to make an equivalent fraction.

combine-numerators.title: Add or subtract
combine-numerators.explanation: With a common denominator, add or subtract the numerators only.
combine-numerators.guidance: Keep the denominator: the size of each part has not changed.

simplify.title: Simplify
simplify.explanation: Equivalent fractions describe the same amount. Simplest form uses no common factor greater than 1.
simplify.guidance: Divide the numerator and denominator by the same common factor.
